name: steerlink
description: Steer and remote-control Claude Code from Grok Bot: delegate coding tasks, review every diff, and approve or deny each change. Also works with Codex and other ACP coding agents.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.title: Anthropic API key
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Your own key from the Claude Console (platform.claude.com). Usage is billed directly to your Anthropic account.

ACP_CONNECTOR_SESSION_VIEW.title: Session view
ACP_CONNECTOR_SESSION_VIEW.description: auto (default): show the live session view only where the app declares support. on: offer it anyway, to try whether the app renders it. off: never.
